subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Representativeness: Judging by Resemblance
description: One-minute skill: Representativeness: Judging by Resemblance.

hook.text: Steve is shy and loves detail. Librarian or farmer? Most say librarian. But farmers outnumber librarians 20:1.

buildup.text: We judge probability by how well a description fits a category, ignoring the category's actual size.

discovery.text: Representativeness: we classify by similarity to a prototype, not by statistical likelihood.

twist.text: A sequence of HTHTHT looks less random than HHHHHH, yet both are equally probable in coin flips.

climax.text: Pattern-matching is fast and usually helpful. But when base rates matter, it leads us astray.

punchline.text: Looking the part isn't being the part.

quiz.question: What does the representativeness heuristic cause us to ignore?
options: How well a person fits a description
